caption: A decoder-only transformer at a glance: text becomes token IDs, each ID becomes a vector with position added, a stack of attention-plus-feed-forward blocks mixes information between tokens, and a final softmax turns the last vector into a probability for every token in the vocabulary.
alt: Text is tokenised into integer IDs. Each ID is looked up in an embedding table and positional information is added. The vectors pass through a block made of self-attention, where each token becomes a weighted mix of the others, and a feed-forward layer; this block is repeated many times. The final vector for the last position goes through a softmax over the vocabulary to give the next-token probabilities, one token is chosen and appended, and the process repeats.
